damageLaw: In the Ice Caves no blow is an instant KO since v29.70: a swordsman's cut and the Ferocious Yeti's landing on a lesser foot soldier and the falling ice on any man land the KO price (31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP by tier), and since v31.24 a spearman's charge and a cut on Sarge, the medic, a spared heavy or a hero one rifleman bar (22 · 22 · 22 · 29 HP), each whole as HP x bar / his HP of his bar hits: a rifleman falls, any other man stands on 15 % of a full bar (the floor); one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men; every other blow is bar hits x the share x the damper. King Yeti's and King Rex's hide bounces every cave creature's bar hit (only the ice takes them); the saber Sarge turns about half; a man left alone 4 s mends one bar hit. Difficulty scales the bodies by the raid curve (x1 · 1.5 · 2.2 · 2.64), your bar in the caves (x1.25 · 1.2 · 1.15 · 1.1 for every man but Sarge, the flame, the bazooka and the commando x1.5 · 1.5 · 1.4 · 1.3 more) and the pace, doubles the bar hits from HARD, deepens the chomp and lengthens the dark; no rung price rides the caves.
headlines: No blow in the caves kills outright any more (since v29.70): a swordsman's cut and THE FEROCIOUS YETI's landing (THE CHOMP, 58 px wide) on a lesser foot soldier and the falling ice on any man land the KO price, 31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole by tier; a spearman's charge and a cut on Sarge, the medic, a spared heavy or a hero land one rifleman bar, 22 · 22 · 22 · 29 HP whole (since v31.24). A rifleman falls to any of them; every other man stands, on 15 % of his bar if the blow would have emptied a full one (the floor, since v31.00); the jeep and the tank are still wrecked by the ice.

Every other blow is bar hits off the one bar every man carries (on EASY 8.75 for the men, 7.5 for the medic, 12 for the saber Sarge) x the share x the damper (50 % of every blow lands since v29.17): a cave yeti's landing, a fisher's fish and the stomp 1 · 1 · 2 · 2 by tier, the chase's run 2, a cut on Sarge, the medic or a spared heavy 3, THE CHOMP on them 2 · 3 · 4 · 4. And the heavies are heavy here (since v29.13): on top of the caves' bar (x1.25 · 1.2 · 1.15 · 1.1 by tier for every man but Sarge) the flame, the bazooka and the commando carry x1.5 · 1.5 · 1.4 · 1.3 more, so on EASY a flame (99 HP) stands 29 landings to a rifleman's 19 (22 HP).

King Yeti and King Rex are the exception the other way: every cave creature's blow bounces off their hide (the whole cave family counts as thrown snow), the falling ice alone lands on them, as the KO price (measured: 56 of 56 blows turned per hero over the tiers and engines; the ice took 38.2 of King Yeti's 285 bar hits on EASY).

The saber Sarge turns about half of every bar-hit blow (measured 2–9 of 10 landings, 3–7 of 10 cuts, 5–8 of 10 chomps); the priced blows are his to turn too (measured: the charge, the cut and the shard turned or landed whole), and he is not a foot soldier: a cut lands one rifleman bar on him (22 · 22 · 22 · 29 HP whole), the chomp 2 · 3 · 4 · 4 bar hits, the ice the KO price (31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole; the pistol Sarge stands on 15 % of his bar, the floor).

A commando's shield breaks the first falling shard over him or over any man within 120 px of him, his one charge; the second lands the KO price on him (measured on every tier: 6.75 of his 15 bar hits on EASY, he stood). One blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (the cap, since v31.00; measured on one stomp).

His bar is 2312 · 3083 · 4624 · 5670 solo at the lab's levels 45 · 47 · 48 · 50: the designers' time-to-kill chart's cell on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD and the player-damage-threshold pass's on MEGA (the sheet's row runs at x5.1378 · 4.5674 · 4.6707 · 4.7724 over the base; no rung price in the caves); a party grows it x(1 + 0.9 a commander past the first), measured as born: 4393 · 5855 · 8786 · 10771 with two. Under 60 % THE CAVE-IN (the dark, the band of ice 9 · 13 · 16 · 18 s), under 25 % THE CHASE (on the floor for good at 140 · 165 · 190 · 210 px/s).

Difficulty changes the bar hits (1 on EASY and MEDIUM, 2 from HARD), THE CHOMP (2 · 3 · 4 · 4), the bodies (x1 · 1.5 · 2.2 · 2.64), your bar in the caves (x1.25 · 1.2 · 1.15 · 1.1; the heavies x1.5 · 1.5 · 1.4 · 1.3 more), the pace (the cave creatures x0.7 · 0.75 · 0.8 · 0.85, he x0.75 · 0.8 · 0.85 · 0.9), the head-counts (2 · 2 · 3 · 3 cave yetis a burst; 1–4 spearmen, 1–2 fishers, 1–3 swordsmen live), the storm (7 · 6 · 12 · 12 s) and the lab's level; THE RAVAGE is HARD's and MEGA's alone.

units.name: SPEARMAN
units.note: the premiere at 16 · 14 · 13 · 12 s by tier; 1 · 2 · 3 · 4 live at a time (a party adds one); pays 64 · 58 · 51 · 48 dog tags

attacks.name: THE CHARGE
attacks.cadence: planted at the lip 0.45 s (forepaw dust), the heading locked on the nearest man within 460 px, then straight down the line at 380 px/s and 100 px past him; a 1.6 s rest planted, then back in
attacks.note: one rifleman bar since v31.24 (the spear fells a rifleman): 22 · 22 · 22 · 29 HP by tier (the rifleman's HP at the KO price's rank), landing whole as HP x bar / his HP of his bar hits (no share, no damper) on every man within 38 px of his line, once a charge, and a 60 px bowl-over: a rifleman falls, any other man stands on 15 % of a full bar (the floor; measured on EASY the M. gunner kept 3.25 of 8.75 bar hits, the medic 1.12 of 7.5); was 1 · 1 · 2 · 2 bar hits x the share; the saber Sarge turns about half; King Yeti and King Rex turn it (the hide); a rim or the edge stops him

bossMoves.effect: the KO price on a lesser foot soldier (31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole); bar hits on the rest
bossMoves.cadence: his landing out of a hole: a 0.55 s flight at the man deepest in your line (every third strike out of the back hole), two eyes lit 0.6 · 0.45 · 0.35 · 0.25 s before; one strike in seven is this alone, four are rampages, two stomps
bossMoves.note: no KO since v29.70: every lesser foot soldier within 58 px of where he lands takes the KO price, 31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole (a rifleman falls; measured on EASY the M. gunner kept 0.88 of 8.75 bar hits, on MEGA 1.16 of 7.7, the floor); the flame, the bazooka and the commando (spared since v29.13), Sarge, the medic, the jeep, the tank and a hero take 2 · 3 · 4 · 4 bar hits x the share x the damper and a 80 px bowl-over (the saber turns about half: measured 5–8 of 10; King Yeti and King Rex turn every one)
bossMoves.code: updateFoeFyeti 'strike' -> fyLand (FY_LAND_R; DY_FOOT -> knockKill; a heavy unfooted by icpUnfoot where CAVES_SPARE; FY_PIPS -> tanHit)

bossMoves.name: THE RAMPAGE
bossMoves.effect: the KO price on the foot soldiers under each landing (31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole); one bar hit lighter for the rest
bossMoves.cadence: four strikes of seven: the landing, then 2 · 3 · 4 · 5 more bounds in a chain at the nearest man within 420 px, 0.42 s a bound
bossMoves.note: each landing lands the KO price on the lesser foot soldiers under it (no KO since v29.70) and takes 1 · 2 · 3 · 3 bar hits x the share x the damper off everyone else, the three spared heavies too (one lighter than the chomp; measured on EASY: the medic took 1, the rifleman beside him fell)
bossMoves.code: fyLand(FY_PIPS - FY_RAMP_PIPS_DN) on the follow-up bounds (FY_RAMP_N, FY_RAMP_R)

bossMoves.name: THE STOMP
bossMoves.cadence: two strikes of seven: he lands, rises 0.35 s (the amber ring), and the shockwave lands
bossMoves.note: 1 · 1 · 2 · 2 bar hits shipped, landing at 50 % under the damper since v29.17, x the share on every man within 150 px and a 130 px bowl-over (measured on every man at 60 px; King Yeti and King Rex turn it). Since Nov 10 the jig after it hits: four little hops in place, each 7 bar hits x the share x the damper on every man within 80 px of his feet who is not still sliding from the bowl-over (the flame, the bazooka and the commando x0.5 · 0.5 · 0.45 · 0.4; from full health a hop lands at most 90 % of a bar): measured with the man held at 40 px, a rifleman falls at hop 3 on EASY, a flame stands the four. One stomp reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (the cap; measured)
bossMoves.code: fyStomp (FY_ST_R, FY_ST_PIPS) -> tanHit; fymHop (FY_HOP_R, FY_HOP_DMG, FY_HOP_HEAVY); rzbCapped (RZB_CAP)

bossMoves.name: THE FALLING ICE
bossMoves.effect: the KO price on every man under a shard (31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole); the machines wrecked
bossMoves.cadence: from his arrival, every 7 · 6 · 12 · 12 s a volley of 2 · 3 · 2 · 2 clusters of three shadows, each cluster aimed at a man on his feet; a shadow grows 1.8 s, then the shard lands; inside THE CAVE-IN the band's rows instead
bossMoves.note: no KO since v29.70: every man within 40 px of the shadow takes the KO price, 31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole, Sarge of every iron and every hero too (the hide does not turn it): a rifleman falls, any other man stands on 15 % of a full bar (measured on every tier, both engines, 1 s after the shadow: the rifleman fell, the M. gunner kept 0.88 of 8.75 bar hits on EASY, the pistol Sarge stood on the floor, the Claymore's counted block turned it); the jeep and the tank are still wrecked (a machine is never priced). A commando's shield breaks the first shard over him or over any man within 120 px of him, his one charge (measured: the rifleman in his circle stood; a second shard over the commando killed him). Wyatt 9/25: the stalagmites destroy just about any unit; THE KO PASS leaves this a kill on his word.

bossBarsNote: the game's own sheet for 1 to 10 commanders at the lab's level: the solo bar (the designers' time-to-kill chart's cell on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD and the player-damage-threshold pass's on MEGA) x (1 + 0.9 a commander past the first), within 3 HP (the wrap writes the row's multiplier at four decimals); the boss born in a party of 2, 3 and 5 was measured at exactly these bars on every tier, both engines. No rung price rides the caves, so THE BOSS LAB's slider and a real party read the same.

changes.what: THE STOMP'S LITTLE HOPS: his jig after the stomp hits, four hops in place, each 7 bar hits x the share x the damper on every man within 80 px of his feet who is not still sliding from the bowl-over (the heavies x0.5 · 0.5 · 0.45 · 0.4; from full health a hop lands at most 90 % of a bar); measured with the man held at 40 px: a rifleman falls at hop 3 on EASY, a flame stands the four. His arms, body and face move in every move. Landed after v31.30; in the v32.45 read.

THE ICICLES MAKE THE HOLES: from his arrival a heavy icicle falls on its own clock (every 16 · 14 · 12 · 1 s, at most 2 · 3 · 3 · 4 made holes open) at a spot hashed off the fight's seed, never aimed at a man; under it a unit takes what a shard deals (the KO price); the crater is a hole and a yeti door until the water flash-freezes it (14 · 16 · 18 · 2 s). Off in this read's stagings (it lands through the shard's own door, measured). In the v32.45 read.
The cave yeti pays 1 · 1 · 1 · 1 dog tags less: 30 · 26 · 22 · 20 by tier (was 40 · 36 · 32 · 30 on v29.45; measured as born). In the v32.45 read.

THE SPEAR AND THE SWORD FELL A RIFLEMAN: a spearman's charge and a cut on Sarge, the medic, a spared heavy or a hero land one rifleman bar, 22 · 22 · 22 · 29 HP whole (was 1 · 1 · 2 · 2 and 3 bar hits x the share): a rifleman falls, the M. gunner keeps 3.25 of 8.75 bar hits on EASY, the medic stands on 15 %. And the fisher's Snappers, the big puff of snow, MISSION ACCOMPLISHED!

THE FLOOR: on EASY to MEGA no single hit fells a non-rifleman (Sarge counts) from a full bar, he stands on 15 % of it; a rifleman falls. THE CAP: one blow (a spot inside 0.75 s) reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (measured: one stomp over the cap + 2 riflemen, 2 took nothing). ULTRA MEGA reads none of it.

NO INSTANT KO: the swordsman's cut and THE CHOMP on a lesser foot soldier and the falling ice on any man land the KO price, 0.9 x the M. gunner's HP at the chart's rank for the caves' level (80 -> rank 46; MEGA 120 -> 69) = 31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole: a rifleman falls, everyone else stands (the floor since v31.00), a machine under the ice is still wrecked. THE HEAVY CLASS: the bazooka, the flame and the commando read max(their own HP, 2 x the M. gunner's) for the big blows: at level 45 the bazooka 60 -> 70 HP, the commando 69 -> 70; at 50 74 -> 80 and 83 -> 83 (was = client v29.45); their bars unchanged.

The bazooka's and the commando's tenth-rank HP bonus doubled (+10 HP a rung) and shotgun Sarge wears +20 HP per ten shotgun ranks while the shotgun is in his hands: at the lab's level 45 to 48 the bazooka 40 → 60 HP, the commando 49 → 69, the shotgun Sarge 32 → 112; at 50: 49 → 74, 58 → 83, 35 → 135 (was = client v29.24). A bar hit lands a hair lighter on them; the kill doors do not care.

The flame's +6 HP every tenth rank pays three times that through level 50: at the lab's level 45 to 48 the flame 51 → 99 HP, at 50: 61 → 121 (was = client v29.24). He stands the bar-hit blows longer (WHO SURVIVES); the cut and THE CHOMP already spare him since v29.13; the ice still kills.

THE DESIGNERS' TIME-TO-KILL CHART: his bar for one commander on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD is the chart's cell, 1080 · 1890 · 1881 → 2312 · 3083 · 4624 HP (was = client v29.24); the wrap writes the sheet row's multiplier over the base at the fight's birth (x2.4 · 2.8 · 1.9 → x5.1378 · 4.5674 · 4.6707, the dial under it unchanged), so a party bar lands within 3 HP of solo x (1 + 0.9 a commander past the first): with two 2052 · 3590 · 3574 → 4393 · 5855 · 8786. MEGA's bar is the player-damage-threshold pass's (the row below).

THE PLAYER-DAMAGE-THRESHOLD PASS: his bar for one commander on MEGA is the pass's table number, 3089 → 5670 HP (was = client v29.24; the row runs at x4.7724 over the base, the dial x2.6 under it); with two 5868 → 10771. Its EASY · MEDIUM · HARD cells gave way to the designers' time-to-kill chart the same day (the row above).
THE DAMPER: every enemy blow on your men lands at 50 % of its size in the campaign and every boss fight (the Boss Lab too), so a man stands about twice the bar-hit blows; a kill blow is still a kill.

THE PACING PASS: the cave creatures step x0.7 · 0.75 · 0.8 · 0.85 and THE FEROCIOUS YETI x0.75 · 0.8 · 0.85 · 0.9 by tier; every bar of your side but Sarge x1.25 · 1.2 · 1.15 · 1.1, the flame's, the bazooka's and the commando's x1.5 · 1.5 · 1.4 · 1.3 more; the swordsman's cut and THE CHOMP spare those three (they take the bar hits); the falling ice still kills.
A hole's rim steers a man's step, a man pushed across a rim falls in (the pit law), the hand is refused at a rim.

The caves' purse: a cave creature pays its bounty x 4 · 3.6 · 3.2 · 3 dog tags by tier (a cave yeti 30 · 26 · 22 · 20, a swordsman 120 · 108 · 96 · 90; measured as born); a man the cave-in's band kills gets x1 · 1 · 0.75 · 0.5 of his price back in all.
The caves pan down for the hand like the flat rugs, so the bottom row of holes clears the troop tray on a phone.
The quiet start: the first burst at 8 · 6 · 5 · 4 s by tier (was 2.5 everywhere), the three holes nearest the toy box asleep till 25 · 20 · 15 · 10 s, the lab forgets the speed dial on a reload.

+3 HP every tenth rank for the bazooka, grenadier, flame and commando (the grenadier at level 45 to 48: 37 HP; at 50: 45; the bazooka's, the flame's and the commando's rungs re-priced since: the rows above); a bar hit lands a hair lighter on them, the kill doors do not care.
One HP number: a bar hit lands 90 % + 10 % x bar / HP of itself.
The Boss Lab fights the caves with its stock army at level 45 · 47 · 48 · 50.
A party grows his bar (x1 + 0.9 a commander past the first) instead of multiplying him.
His bar's dial re-priced for a fight all on the floor: x2.4 · 2.8 · 1.9 · 2.6 by tier (since Nov 2 the chart's bar and the threshold pass's are written over it).
A commando's shield breaks a falling shard over him or any man within 120 px, once.
His bar down 20 % on every difficulty (Wyatt 10/3); the fisher throws at a plane nearer than his man.
The pace: the cave-in's band walks its span in 9 · 13 · 16 · 18 s; MEGA's swordsmen 1 a call, 2 live; the roar wakes 2 cave yetis on MEGA.

The hits land: the swordsman's cut downs a foot soldier; the falling ice is aimed at the men. CARD-YF3 the same day: his landing kills the foot soldiers under it (58 px) and the rampage is his default landing. CARD-CF: the storm kills (Wyatt 9/25). CARD-YF4: the storm's pace by tier.

questions.text: The bar question for Raziya, half answered by Wyatt's pacing pass (v29.13): the caves' bar is now x1.25 · 1.2 · 1.15 · 1.1 by tier for every man but Sarge and the flame, the bazooka and the commando carry x1.5 · 1.5 · 1.4 · 1.3 more, so on EASY a flame stands 29 landings to a rifleman's 19. The other men still carry one bar whatever their HP (a mortar, a grenadier and a rifleman stand the same count). A bar by HP class for the rest, or as is? Nothing is proposed on this page (Wyatt 11/1 15:15: ask, propose nothing).

THE FALLING ICE was the one kill the KO pass kept on Wyatt's word (9/25: "the stalagmites, when they fall, need to destroy just about any unit"; 11/1: keep it a kill). CARD-BDC2 (v29.70, Isaac's pass: "there shouldn't be any attacks in the game that just have an instant KO mechanic, even on the boss fight") now prices it like every other KO: 31.5 · 31.5 · 31.5 · 40.5 HP whole, so only a rifleman falls under a shard and every other man stands. Intended for the caves?
questions.rec: as is (the newer word, Isaac's no-instant-KO pass with Wyatt's go); say so if the ice should stay a kill in the caves alone

questions.text: King Yeti and King Rex take nothing from any cave creature's blow (their hide bounces thrown snow, and the whole cave family counts as snow); only the falling ice takes them. Intended?
questions.rec: a read for Raziya; if the kings should feel the caves, the cave family's snow flag is the one cell

questions.text: A commando's shield breaks the first falling shard over him or over any man within 120 px, then he is spent for the fight; the second shard lands the KO price on him (he stands). Intended as the one roof against the ice?
questions.rec: as is (Wyatt 10/5: the reflect shield negates the falling icicles); a read
